Energy-demanding post-mitotic tissues (central nervous system grey and white matter, skeletal muscle, and myocardium) are preferentially vulnerable, producing the characteristic Leigh-spectrum, leukodystrophy, and cardiomyopathic phenotypes.

nodes.description: Elevated blood or urinary lactate and ketotic/lactic-acidotic organic acid profiles from impaired oxidative metabolism; lactate elevation in SDHA deficiency is often mild or intermittent (for example 3.7 mmol/L in a neonatal cardiomyopathy cohort, or normal random plasma lactate alongside elevated urinary lactate and ketotic acylcarnitines).

nodes.description: Oral supplementation with riboflavin, the biosynthetic precursor of the covalently bound FAD cofactor of SDHA, is used empirically in isolated mitochondrial complex II deficiency; in biochemically diagnosed complex II-deficient children and fibroblasts whose molecular subunit genotype was not determined (Bugiani et al., 2006), riboflavin doubled residual fibroblast complex II activity and was associated with biochemical or neurological stabilization, though clinical efficacy has not been established in genetically confirmed SDHA cohorts.

evidence.reference_title: Effects of riboflavin in children with complex II deficiency.

evidence.reference_title: Effects of riboflavin in children with complex II deficiency.
